user.title: Create a PT Alarm panel
user.description: Give your alarm panel a name and, optionally, a first user code. Next you can add sensors. Everything can be changed later under **Configure**.

data_description.code: At least 4 characters. Digits-only codes give you a numeric keypad.

sensors.title: Add sensors
sensors.description: Choose the door, window, motion and other sensors that belong to this alarm. You can skip this and add sensors later.

sensor_types.title: Sensor types
sensor_types.description:
Choose a type for each sensor. The type sets sensible defaults (active modes, entry delay or immediate). We guessed where we could.

{sensors}

error.code_too_short: The code must be at least 4 characters.

abort.already_configured: A panel with this name already exists.

init.title: PT Alarm configuration
init.description: {sensors} sensor(s) and {users} user(s) configured. Each change is saved as soon as you click **Submit**. Close this window when you are done.

data.auto_bypass: Automatically bypass open sensors when arming
data.disarm_after_trigger: Disarm after the trigger time ends
data.max_attempts: Invalid code attempts before lockout (0 = never)

mode_settings.title: Mode: {mode}
mode_settings.description: Exit delay: time to leave after arming. Entry delay: time to disarm after a delayed sensor opens. Trigger time: how long the alarm stays triggered (0 = until disarmed).

sensor_add.title: Add sensors
sensor_add.description: Choose the sensors to add. On the next screen you choose a type for each one.

data.always_on: Always on (24 hours, even when disarmed)

user_add.title: Add a user
user_add.description: Codes are stored hashed and cannot be read back.

data_description.code: At least 4 characters. Digits only gives a numeric keypad.
data_description.start_time: If the start is later than the end (for example 22:00 to 06:00), the window runs overnight.
data_description.valid_until: Leave the dates empty for a permanent code.
data_description.blocked_by: The code is refused while any of these is on, for example a Holiday calendar, a Yom Tov sensor or a vacation switch.

data_description.notify_services: For example notify.mobile_app_my_phone. Custom values are allowed.

arm.name: Arm
arm.description: Arm a PT Alarm panel, with optional force arming and delay skipping.

force.name: Force
force.description: Arm even when sensors are open; the open sensors are bypassed.

skip_delay.name: Skip exit delay
skip_delay.description: Arm immediately without the exit delay.
